title: Conjecture on the Laplacian eigenvalue distribution of graphs with given diameter
statement:
Let $G$ be a connected graph of order $n$ with diameter $d\ge 2$. For an interval of indices, write $m_G[a,b]$ for the number of Laplacian eigenvalues of $G$ whose indices lie between $a$ and $b$, inclusive.

**Laplacian eigenvalue distribution conjecture.** If $c=0,\dots,d-2$ and

$$
\max\{2,c\}\le d\le n-2-c,
$$

then

$$
m_G[n-d+2-c,n]\le n-d+c.
$$

The conjecture concerns how many of the largest Laplacian eigenvalues a connected graph of diameter $d$ can have in the indicated index range. The source states that it is known for $c=0,1,2,d-3,d-2$, while the general case remains open.
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2401.03777

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of January 2024).
source_name: Leyou Xu and Bo Zhou, “Diameter vs Laplacian eigenvalue distribution”, arXiv:2401.03777 (2024).
